content.text: Now let me check the data to understand the date format and find claims from February 2025:

input.sql: SELECT DISTINCT FLX_ANN_MOI, SOI_ANN, SOI_MOI FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS LIMIT 20

content.text: I can see that FLX_ANN_MOI appears to be the processing month (202502 = February 2025, 202501 = January 2025, etc.). Now let me query for the top 3 prescribing provider activities by amount charged in February 2025:

input.sql:
SELECT 
  pa.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB,
  SUM(fr.PRS_ACT_COG) as total_charged
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY pa ON fr.PSE_ACT_SNDS = pa.PSE_ACT_SNDS
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202502 
  AND fr.PSE_ACT_SNDS IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pa.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB
ORDER BY total_charged DESC
LIMIT 3

content.text: Perfect! I found the three prescribing provider activities with the highest amount charged before reimbursement in February 2025. Let me verify this result is correct by checking if there are any NULL values that should be excluded:

input.sql:
SELECT 
  pa.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB,
  SUM(fr.PRS_ACT_COG) as total_charged
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY pa ON fr.PSE_ACT_SNDS = pa.PSE_ACT_SNDS
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202502 
  AND fr.PSE_ACT_SNDS IS NOT NULL
  AND pa.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pa.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB
ORDER BY total_charged DESC
